effectEntries.effect: Changes the weather to Shadow Sky for five turns. Pokémon other than Shadow Pokémon take 1/16 their max HP at the end of every turn. This move is typeless for the purposes of Weather Ball.
effectEntries.shortEffect: Changes the weather to Shadow Sky for five turns.
